params.name: fordisplay
params.description: List resources by display flag; only ROOT admin is eligible to pass this parameter

params.name: account
params.description: List resources by Account. Must be used with the domainId parameter.

params.name: name
params.description: List network ACLs by specified name

params.name: vpcid
params.description: List network ACLs by VPC ID

params.name: projectid
params.description: List objects by project; if projectid=-1 lists All Instances

params.name: networkid
params.description: List network ACLs by network ID

params.name: id
params.description: Lists network ACL with the specified ID.

params.name: isrecursive
params.description: Defaults to false, but if true, lists all resources from the parent specified by the domainId till leaves.

params.name: domainid
params.description: List only resources belonging to the domain specified

params.name: listall
params.description: If set to false, list only resources belonging to the command's caller; if set to true - list resources that the caller is authorized to see. Default value is false. Resources dedicated to a project are listed only if using the projectid parameter.

response.name: fordisplay
response.description: Is ACL for display to the regular user

response.name: vpcname
response.description: Name of the VPC this ACL is associated with

response.name: jobstatus
response.description: The current status of the latest async job acting on this object

response.name: jobid
response.description: The UUID of the latest async job acting on this object

response.name: vpcid
response.description: Id of the VPC this ACL is associated with
